name: holdout-retro
description: A retrospective with interruptions and questions at the end of turns.
lines: them-1
Okay, retro time. What went well this sprint? Let's start with the release itself.
them-2
I think the release went really smoothly, the new checklist helped a lot.
them-3
Agreed, although the staging environment was down for most of Tuesday, which cost us a day of testing.
them-2
Sorry, can I just add, that wasn't the first time, staging has been flaky all month.
them-1
Sorry Hannah, go on, you were saying about Tuesday.
them-3
Just that we should have a fallback, maybe a second staging environment for the release week.
them-1
Good idea. What do you think, Lee?
them-2
I'd support that, as long as someone owns keeping it in sync.
them-1
Great. Hannah, can you write that up as a proposal?
them-3
Sure, I'll have it by Friday.
